the count is now stated as past the intended edge, with ADR-023's refusal of a sixth as the standing precedent (discharges ADR-023 RT-4). v1.65.0: five skills gain the forgeplan tools that existed all along and were invoked by nothing (marketplace#263, each probed live before wiring): /gate-check gets contradictions (honest v1 label: title-duplicates only) + orphans (conditional — brownfield-only, always empty elsewhere, so calling it there would manufacture a check that verifies nothing); /wrap gets coverage + capture; /decay-watch finally calls its name-twin forgeplan_decay (measured cost stated: >2min on a 385-artifact graph); /forge-heal gets undo_last strictly for destructive ops; /progress-dashboard gets forgeplan_progress. v1.64.0: three routing-map defects measured against agent frontmatter on disk (EVID-231) — the claim/claims denylist policy at :351 was stated inverted (B denies the plural read forgeplan_claims and KEEPS claim/release; smith is the mirror image), discover was labelled Profile B while its body declares A three times, and row 12 phase 2 named research-analyst as the post-incident PRD author when its denylist forbids creating anything — specification now writes the PRD from its read-only synthesis. 44 engineering skills + dev-advisor agent + 5 hooks (+ smith greeting + insight watchdog). v1.63.0: NEW /estimate and /wrap - the two pipeline stages that had never been built. The dispatch matrix marked both `primary: "inline"`, a sentinel meaning "the orchestrator writes a couple of lines", so `forgeplan estimate` was never called on the pipeline path and ADR-020's REFRESH cycle-close node - decided in full, reaching the authoring guide and the routing map - never reached the executor: the word `refresh` appeared nowhere in /forge-cycle. /estimate reports the confidence REASONS behind the number and pairs it with an R_eff snapshot; /wrap runs drift + stale + /forge-heal + a link audit and, at Deep and Critical, records their actual output in a REFRESH artifact. New matrix sentinel `skill:<name>` for stages the orchestrator performs itself rather than dispatching (marketplace#233, #234). Same release, the PR-evidence hook stops blocking on work it cannot fix: it now reads artifact IDs from base..HEAD instead of a flat `git log -20` (a reference in somebody else's already-merged commit was blocking unrelated PRs), and an ID that is not in the graph is reported as not-found instead of as "evidence missing" with a remedy that cannot work — you cannot link an EVID to an artifact that does not exist. Both pinned by a new mutation-checked suite, and `validate-all-plugins.sh` now runs the plugin test suites CI was already running. v1.52.0: AGENT-AUTHORING-GUIDE gains a companion "Autonomous build-workflow discipline" section (marketplace#169) + the build/sprint/do skills codify its 3 patterns - bake project red lines verbatim into the design/build prompt (catch spec-vs-constraint violations before code), spec-as-built reconciliation before activation (an omitted-by-redline mandate must be reconciled in the artifact body, not silently left stale), and self-verify + claim-sweep on agent crash (never ship on an unverified crashed-agent claim, never leave an orphaned claim). v1.51.0: AGENT-AUTHORING-GUIDE gains three canonical disciplines - claim-hygiene (read-only agents never claim; orchestrator pre-checks forgeplan_claims + sweeps orphans, marketplace#166), StructuredOutput-
